experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Small synthetic dataset, standard classifier, fits comfortably in one CPU job.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether class-weighted logistic regression improves minority-class recall over an unweighted baseline on imbalanced tabular data.
experiment_plans.design: Controlled comparison: identical model and split, weighting on vs off.

data_requirements.description: Imbalanced binary tabular dataset, roughly 10% positive class, 8 numeric features.
preprocessing_steps: Generate the imbalanced dataset with a fixed seed
Standardize features on the training split only

methods.name: logistic regression
methods.description: Gradient-descent logistic regression with optional per-class weights.

evaluation.baseline: Unweighted logistic regression on the same split.
evaluation.success_criteria: Weighted model improves minority-class recall by at least 0.05 without losing more than 0.03 accuracy.

implementation_steps.description: Compare both on the held-out split

risks: The synthetic dataset may be too easy to separate the two conditions.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
